cards.target: Estou aprendendo a dirigir.

cards.target: Estou precisando de férias.
cards.english: I need a vacation.

cards.target: Estou me sentindo melhor hoje.

cards.target: Preciso parar de procrastinar.

cards.target: Estou trabalhando de casa hoje.

cards.target: Acabamos de receber a notícia.

cards.target: Continuamos procurando uma solução.
cards.english: We keep looking for a solution.

cards.target: Apesar de cansados, continuamos caminhando.

cards.target: Estou tentando comer menos açúcar.
cards.english: I'm trying to eat less sugar.

cards.target: Eles andam brigando muito ultimamente.
cards.english: They've been fighting a lot lately.

cards.target: Ela continua trabalhando mesmo doente.
cards.english: She keeps working even when sick.

cards.target: Ela anda meio distante ultimamente.
cards.english: She's been kind of distant lately.

cards.target: Nem por isso deixei de tentar.
cards.english: That didn't stop me from trying.

cards.target: Contudo, a decisão final é sua.
cards.english: However, the final decision is yours.

cards.target: Ele acabou de chegar do aeroporto.
cards.english: He just arrived from the airport.

cards.target: Ela anda reclamando de tudo ultimamente.
cards.english: She's been complaining about everything lately.

cards.target: Ele precisa de melhorar a comunicação.
cards.english: He needs to improve his communication.

cards.target: Por via das dúvidas, leva um casaco.
cards.english: Just in case, bring a jacket.

cards.target: Com efeito, os números comprovam a tendência.
cards.english: Indeed, the numbers confirm the trend.

cards.target: Ele anda trabalhando até tarde todo dia.
cards.english: He's been working late every day.

cards.target: De modo geral, estou satisfeito com o resultado.
cards.english: Overall, I'm satisfied with the result.

cards.target: Conquanto haja dificuldades, vamos superar.
cards.english: Although there are difficulties, we'll overcome them.

cards.target: Mesmo assim, decidi continuar tentando.
cards.english: Even so, I decided to keep trying.

cards.target: Ainda que pareça impossível, vamos tentar.
cards.english: Even if it seems impossible, we'll try.

cards.target: Conquanto seja arriscado, vale a tentativa.
cards.english: Although it's risky, it's worth a try.

cards.target: De toda forma, agradeço o convite.
cards.english: In any case, I appreciate the invitation.

cards.target: Com base nisso, tomamos a decisão.
cards.english: Based on that, we made the decision.

cards.target: Tenho que resolver esse problema hoje.
cards.english: I have to solve this problem today.

cards.target: Ela perguntou quanto custava a passagem.
cards.english: She asked how much the ticket cost.

cards.target: Manda uma mensagem quando chegar em casa.
cards.english: Send a message when you get home.

cards.target: Em suma, o projeto foi um sucesso.
cards.english: In short, the project was a success.

cards.target: Até porque ele nunca foi muito pontual.
cards.english: Besides, he was never very punctual.

cards.target: Estou chegando, espera só mais cinco minutos.
cards.english: I'm almost there, just wait another five minutes.

cards.target: O médico recomendou que eu descansasse mais.
cards.english: The doctor recommended that I rest more.

cards.target: Tô na correria, não posso parar agora.
cards.english: I'm super busy, I can't stop now.

cards.target: Por conseguinte, a empresa decidiu encerrar as atividades.
cards.english: Consequently, the company decided to end operations.

cards.target: Ela deixou de acreditar em Papai Noel cedo.
cards.english: She stopped believing in Santa Claus early.

cards.target: Começo a entender o que você quer dizer.
cards.english: I'm beginning to understand what you mean.

cards.target: Ela passou a prestar mais atenção nas aulas.
cards.english: She started paying more attention in class.

cards.target: Ele me pediu que não contasse para ninguém.
cards.english: He asked me not to tell anyone.

cards.target: Acabei dormindo no sofá.
cards.english: I ended up falling asleep on the sofa.

cards.target: De fato, a situação melhorou bastante.
cards.english: In fact, the situation has improved a lot.

cards.target: Nesse meio-tempo, podemos preparar o material.
cards.english: In the meantime, we can prepare the material.

cards.target: Estou querendo aprender a tocar violão.
cards.english: I want to learn to play guitar.

cards.target: Acabei me acostumando com o calor.
cards.english: I ended up getting used to the heat.

cards.target: Ele é inteligente, porém não se esforça.
cards.english: He's intelligent, but he doesn't make an effort.

cards.target: Ora, isso não faz o menor sentido.
cards.english: Well, that doesn't make any sense at all.

cards.target: Passei a entender melhor depois da explicação.
cards.english: I started to understand better after the explanation.

cards.target: Ela saiu correndo quando ouviu a notícia.
cards.english: She ran out when she heard the news.

cards.target: Estávamos prestes a sair quando ele ligou.
cards.english: We were about to leave when he called.

cards.target: Tenho que tomar uma decisão até amanhã.
cards.english: I have to make a decision by tomorrow.

cards.target: Comecei a me interessar por arte contemporânea.
cards.english: I started to get interested in contemporary art.

cards.target: Ele ficou olhando para mim sem dizer nada.
cards.english: He kept looking at me without saying anything.

cards.target: Ao contrário do que pensam, ele é muito humilde.
cards.english: Contrary to what people think, he's very humble.

cards.target: Tanto que chegou a ser promovido.
cards.english: So much so that he ended up getting promoted.

cards.target: Em face dos acontecimentos, decidimos cancelar.
cards.english: In light of the events, we decided to cancel.

cards.target: Isso posto, passemos ao próximo tópico.
cards.english: That said, let's move on to the next topic.

cards.target: Estávamos jantando quando a luz acabou.
cards.english: We were having dinner when the power went out.

cards.target: Não sei não, acho meio furada.
cards.english: I'm not sure, I think it's a dumb idea.

cards.target: Conforme combinamos, a reunião será às dez.
cards.english: As we agreed, the meeting will be at ten.

existing_tips: 'A despeito de' is a formal synonym of 'apesar de'.
'Tornar a' + infinitive = to do something again – formal.
'À medida que' means 'as/to the extent that' – indicates parallel progression.
'Ter de' + infinitive is slightly more formal than 'ter que'.
'Costumar' + infinitive = to usually do something – habitual action.
